# Sanchar Sharma

> Theoretical physicist and junior group leader specializing in quantum magnonics and cavity opto-magnonics. Based at IFIMAC – Condensed Matter Physics Center, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Spain. Funded by the "la Caixa" Foundation.

## About

Sanchar Sharma is a theorist working on the quantum dynamics of ferromagnets, with the long-term goal of harnessing magnons for quantum applications such as interconnects, transduction between microwave and optical frequencies, and logic operations. His work spans magnon-microwave and magnon-photon interactions, magnon-mediated entanglement and quantum communication, quantum state generation and tomography of magnons, and cavity optomagnonic coupling.

## Research

Three research directions, each with a few representative papers. This is a curated selection, not a complete bibliography — for the full and continuously updated publication list, see the ORCID and Google Scholar profiles linked under Contact.

### Magnons in the Middle

Quantifies how well magnons can mediate quantum communication between units on a chip. Results include a scheme achieving high-purity entanglement through a magnon channel despite weak coupling, and a proposal for magnon-mediated quantum gates between superconducting qubits. His most recent work (2026) is in this direction.

- [High-purity entanglement mediated by magnons despite weak coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.19533) — Sanchar Sharma, arXiv preprint (2026)
- [Magnon-mediated quantum gates for superconducting qubits](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevB.110.104416) — M Dols, Sanchar Sharma, L Bechara, YM Blanter, M Kounalakis, S Viola Kusminskiy, Phys. Rev. B (2024)

### Taming Magnons

Derives measurement theory and state-preparation protocols intended to be experimentally feasible. Contributions include a method for reconstructing the quantum state of magnons from the photon statistics of Brillouin light scattering, together with the reconstruction algorithm; an algorithm giving the explicit sequence of operations that prepares an arbitrary magnon state in cavity magnonics; and the proposal of spin cat states in ferromagnetic insulators.

- [Quantum tomography of magnons using Brillouin light scattering](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevB.110.014416) — Sanchar Sharma, S Viola Kusminskiy, VASV Bittencourt, Phys. Rev. B (2024)
- [Protocol for generating an arbitrary quantum state of the magnetization in cavity magnonics](https://doi.org/10.1088/2515-7639/ac81f0) — Sanchar Sharma, VASV Bittencourt, S Viola Kusminskiy, Journal of Physics: Materials (2022)
- [Spin cat states in ferromagnetic insulators](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevB.103.L100403) — Sanchar Sharma, VASV Bittencourt, AD Karenowska, S Viola Kusminskiy, Phys. Rev. B: Letters (2021)

### When Magnon met Photon — Cavity Optomagnonics

Microscopic theory of magnon-photon coupling and how to enhance it with cavities. Contributions include the theory of light scattering by magnons in whispering-gallery-mode cavities, a proposal for optical cooling of magnons, optimal mode matching and optomagnonic crystal design, and optical signatures that distinguish a quantum from a classical skyrmion.

- [Optical Signatures of Quantum Skyrmions](https://doi.org/10.1103/5c9q-nsb4) — Sanchar Sharma, Christina Psaroudaki, Phys. Rev. Lett. (2026)
- [Optical cooling of magnons](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevLett.121.087205) — Sanchar Sharma, YM Blanter, GEW Bauer, Phys. Rev. Letters (2018)
- [Light scattering by magnons in whispering gallery mode cavities](https://doi.org/10.1103/PhysRevB.96.094412) — Sanchar Sharma, YM Blanter, GEW Bauer, Phys. Rev. B (2017)

## Background

- "la Caixa" Junior Group Leader — IFIMAC, Universidad Autónoma de Madrid, Madrid, Spain (Sep 2025 – present)
- Postdoctoral Researcher — Laboratoire de Physique de l'École Normale Supérieure (LPENS), Paris, France (Apr 2024 – Aug 2025)
- Postdoctoral Researcher — RWTH Aachen, Aachen, Germany (Jan 2023 – Mar 2024)
- Postdoctoral Researcher — Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL), Erlangen, Germany (Nov 2019 – Dec 2022)
- PhD in Applied Physics — Delft University of Technology (TU Delft), Delft, Netherlands (Aug 2015 – Aug 2019)
- B.Tech + M.Tech — Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT-B), Mumbai, India (Aug 2010 – Jun 2015)

## Plain-Language Explanations

Undergraduate-level explanations of the research, published on the website: what magnons are; why quantum magnonics is promising; measuring magnons using light (quantum tomography via Brillouin light scattering); generating an arbitrary quantum state of magnons; and how to observe quantum skyrmions in magnets.
